name: MP Shramik Sewa Helpline
department: Labor Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
beneficiary: Registered workers, unorganized labor, and construction workers in MP
benefits: Information on Sambal Yojana benefits, maternity assistance, worker registration, and financial aid.
eligibility: Registered workers under Shramik Sewa / Sambal scheme in MP
application_process: Dial 1800-155-555 or track benefit status via the Shramik Sewa Portal.
